immutableSelection.rationale: The move asserts that describing nothingness as powerless merely restates rather than supports the claim that a substance must have a cause. That criticism can be true without making any stated finitude, Hilbert, countdown, or personhood bridge more or less credible. Attack on the pro motion bridge is excluded because the move challenges only an unmapped causal premise, not the complete motion-level conclusion.
